_about: Hand-decided FBX material fixes (2026-09-25). A Kit re-import binds a mesh the Kit already knew to its old (often hand-set) material, but a NEW mesh name, such as a LOD the fill batch added, takes the material its FBX names; where the FBX names a material the Kit does not have (`t_cave_troll_set1.001`), the new LOD renders with none (the rgl log's `Unable to find material`, 269 records in 24 names on 2026-09-25). Each FBX slot below is renamed to the Kit material the part's LOD0 is bound to in the Kit today (read from the live and pre-reimport packages), so every LOD binds on every re-import. `slots` renames a slot on every object of the file; `chains` sets a whole LOD chain (`*` every slot, or per slot) where one FBX name must map differently per part. Applied by tools/lod_fill_batch.py --materials.

Race Test/Dol Guldur/SK_DG_Guldur_Uruk_B._why: The Kit has no Dol Guldur a4 (mouth) material and the mouth was never bound, not even before this pass; the pale uruk's mouth material is the stand-in until KEYforce supplies one.

rohan_assets/rohan_noble/roh_nbl_shldr_c._why: The `.b` part uses two slots; its pre-reimport LOD0 held one record each: Material.006 the cloak (the same slot is the cloak in roh_nbl_clk_clo), Material.002 the arm pads.
